_disclosure: A growing, disclosed library of chapter/section-heading conventions this reading agent has actually confirmed against real text — not a closed, hand-typed list of everything English prose might do. Each entry names the exact shape (word, numeral alphabet, whether a period is required) and its provenance: which book required it, and whether it was found mechanically (an already-known convention matched, or a skeleton-recurrence scan proposed a new one on its own) or needed the local-model confirmation tier (structure-rec.mjs's tier 3) before being trusted. See native/READING-SPEC.md S107 for the mechanism this file feeds.
